title: 第21章 善恶魔神一念普度众生一念毁天灭地第22章 仙品功法 太虚原始经
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“说！”
“是，大人，这陈生平帝境九重天，家在大乾神朝南江府临溪城，出生时丧母，幼年丧父，乞讨长大，六岁，偶遇大神通者，获得机缘，得以传授神通，十六岁，达到宗师之境，二十一岁，达到……”
“停停停，挑重点说。”
陆尘听到此言，连忙开口打断。
好家伙，这地府果然是恐怖如斯，这简直是把陈生平调查一个底朝天，从小到大各个阶段都一清二楚。
要知道，这才不到一个时辰时间啊，
陆尘不得不感慨，地府组织果然恐怖无比，不仅杀人在行，而且调查消息也这么灵通
“是，大人！”
酆都鬼帝点头。
“四十五岁，陈生平成为大乾神朝四大顶尖家族灵家供奉，而这灵家家主，便是皇室灵妃的父亲。”
“而这陈生平之所以刺杀大人，是灵家家主听灵妃之言，派出陈生平刺杀大人。”
酆都鬼帝简简意赅的开口。
而陆尘听到此言，却是点了点头，并不意外
“利用背后的娘家来搞我嘛！”
陆尘冷笑，脸上露出了不屑的神色，
“从今天开始，每一天，杀一个灵家之人，一天一个，每杀一个灵家之人，都要让灵妃得到消息。”
陆尘声音阴恻恻的开口，
一个虎头虎脑的孩童，说出如此充满杀气的话，在昏暗的地下室中，显得陆尘极为诡异和恐怖，
“是，大人！”
听到此言，酆都鬼帝点头。

“还有，记住，保险起见，从今天开始，我要和地府彻底割裂，以后我们沟通，便用鬼帝玉佩，没有我的吩咐，地府之人不要进去皇宫之中。”
就在酆都鬼帝即将离开的时候，陆尘开口说道。
“遵命！”
酆都鬼帝对着陆尘拱手，随后伴随着一道阴气，酆都鬼帝便极为诡异的直接在原地消失。
只留下陆尘一个人。
“灵妃，陆轩，陆仁，我要你们娘仨亲眼看着，得罪我的下场，我要让你们在绝望中逐渐陷入死亡。”
陆尘开口，稚嫩的声音充满了杀意，
嘤嘤嘤……
然而了，就在这时，陆尘身后，传来嘤嘤嘤的声音。
随后，小狐狸宛若一个银白色的光影直接跳到陆尘肩膀上。
小狐狸扭头，一双水汪汪的眼睛直勾勾的看着陆尘。
让陆尘本来有些凝重的杀意直接破功，
陆尘伸出手摸了摸小狐狸的脑袋，脸上露出了一丝笑意。
“小狐狸，没事你一个人玩儿哈，还有，你应该有名字的吧，如果我猜的不错的话，你应该叫苏玖玖吧？”
顿了一下，陆尘继续开口。
而小狐狸听到陆尘此言，却是惊讶的嘤嘤嘤的叫了出来，狐狸眼睛里露出了诧异的神色。
看到这一幕，陆尘忍不住笑了笑。
“好了。以后我就叫你玖玖了，你先自己玩儿啊，我修炼会儿哈！”
陆尘摸了摸小狐狸的脑袋开口，
嘤嘤嘤。
content_en:
"Say!"
"Yes, Sir, this Chen Shengping is in the ninth level of the Imperial Realm. His family is in Linxi City, Nanjiang Prefecture of the Daqian Dynasty. He lost his mother when he was born and his father when he was young. He grew up begging. At the age of six, he met someone with great supernatural powers by chance and got the opportunity to teach them. At the age of sixteen, he reached the realm of a master. At the age of twenty-one, he reached..."
"Stop, stop, pick out the key points."
When Lu Chen heard this, he quickly interrupted.
Good guy, this underworld is really terrifying. This is like a thorough investigation of Chen Shengping, from childhood to adulthood.
You know, this is less than an hour,
Lu Chen had to sigh with emotion. The underworld organization is really terrifying. Not only are they good at killing people, but they are also so well-informed about investigation information.
"Yes, sir!"
Fengdu Ghost Emperor nodded.
"At the age of forty-five, Chen Shengping became a worshiper of the Ling family, one of the four top families in the Daqian Dynasty. The head of the Ling family is the father of the imperial concubine Ling."
"And the reason why Chen Shengping assassinated you is because the head of the Ling family listened to Concubine Ling and sent Chen Shengping to assassinate you."
Fengdu Ghost Emperor Jian spoke concisely.
When Lu Chen heard this, he nodded, not surprised.
"You're using my mother-in-law behind my back to get me!"
Lu Chen sneered, with a look of disdain on his face,
"From today on, every day, one person from the Ling family will be killed, one person per day. Every time a person from the Ling family is killed, Concubine Ling must get the news."
Lu Chen spoke in a gloomy voice,
A child with a tough head and a tough brain said such murderous words. In the dark basement, Lu Chen looked extremely weird and terrifying.
"Yes, sir!"
Hearing this, Fengdu Ghost Emperor nodded.
"Also, remember, to be on the safe side, starting today, I will completely separate from the underworld. From now on, when we communicate, we will use the Ghost Emperor Jade Pendant. No one from the underworld will enter the palace without my instructions."
Just when Fengdu Ghost Emperor was about to leave, Lu Chen spoke.
"As you command!"
The Fengdu Ghost Emperor handed over to Lu Chen, and then with a burst of Yin Qi, the Fengdu Ghost Emperor disappeared directly on the spot in an extremely strange way.
Only Lu Chen was left alone.
"Concubine Ling, Lu Xuan, Lu Ren, I want you three to see with your own eyes the consequences of offending me. I will let you gradually fall into death in despair."
Lu Chen spoke, his childish voice full of murderous intent,
嘤嘤嘤……
However, at this moment, a whistling sound came from behind Lu Chen.
Then, the little fox jumped directly onto Lu Chen's shoulder like a silver-white light and shadow.
The little fox turned his head and looked directly at Lu Chen with a pair of watery eyes.
Lu Chen's originally somewhat solemn murderous intention was directly destroyed.
Lu Chen reached out and touched the little fox's head, with a smile on his face.
"Little fox, you can play alone if it's okay. Also, you should have a name. If my guess is correct, your name should be Su Jiujiu, right?"
After a pause, Lu Chen continued to speak.
When the little fox heard Lu Chen's words, he screamed in surprise, with a surprised look in the fox's eyes.
Seeing this scene, Lu Chen couldn't help but smile.
"Okay. I will call you Jiujiu from now on. You can play by yourself first while I practice for a while!"
Lu Chen touched the little fox's head and said,
Ying Ying Ying.
